comment: Tanja is a wonderful lady who loves what she does. While she sometimes takes a little longer than ideal for her demos, she is thorough and explains things well. Her syllabus is more of an idealized version of the semester than what you will actually do, she adjusted it to give us more time for a project. She's pretty chill & always willing to help.

An extremely talented artist who has lived everywhere and has the stories to prove it. Will talk your ear off and doesn't put up with slacking off but really cares about the process and wants you to succeed. I had never taken any Print Making classes before hers and I ended up doing well in the class. Overall Tanja's a super cool person to know.

Beyond simply being an amazing artist, Tanja is a fantastic teacher. There was never a moment when a student come to her for help, and she always gave it happily. While she is quite patient, there were students in my section who repeatedly ignored instructions and showed general lack of respect, and I suspect their grades (deservedly) suffered.

She'll work your butt off but it's very worth it.  She's an easy grader and has a greate sense of humor. She's brilliant and articulate (although english is not her first language) and she's the most tallented artist of all time.  You will feel wholly inadequate but delighted to  know her.

Adds experience (from Bosnia) and insight from professional career.  Allows artisti freedom in an intro class...has "exhibits" for fun instead of critiques.  I'm a recent graduate- one of my fav classes. :)
I just needed to fill my requirement, and her class was interesting and fun.  Printmaking is not something I will use every day, but everyone got my prints for christmas

Tanja is awesome, one of the most interesting and nice profs I've had.  If you're looking to fill your art requirement with something that will actually be fun and challenging, take printmaking!  Careful though... she might turn you into and art major!
